summary: Iteration 45 - Security Hardening Phase 2 end-to-end verification. Backend: 14/14 pytest in test_iteration45.py PASS (payments 404 on unknown session; Stripe webhook 400 without signature; private kind=file media 403 anon / 200 (Accept-Ranges: bytes) with Bearer; public image media 200; club manager societa.prova gets 403 on /users, /security/summary, DELETE /tournaments/{id}?confirm=x and on purge-preview; SA happy path on /users and /security/summary; synthetic tournament qa-ta-delete-45 created via API, DELETE requires non-empty valid ?confirm= and recent /auth/reauth, backup appears in /tournaments/backups and POST /backups/{id}/restore returns 200; purge-preview requires keep_slugs). Frontend (QA Super Admin login via /login?area=staff&mfa=obbligatoria): login-mfa-required-notice visible; after email+password+TOTP user lands in /admin (Control Room). /admin/sicurezza renders data-testid security-page with KPI tiles sec-login-ok (132), sec-login-fail (43), sec-denied (100), sec-blocked (157), sec-disabled (3); security-config has 12 rows + security-config-errors badge ('1 da sistemare') with data-state values seen: configured, active, verified, error (mfa_admins), unverifiable (smtp). security-admins lists 4 SA with MFA/NO MFA labels (liviadm15, alessioodt flagged NO MFA). No QA_PASSWORD/QA_TOTP_SECRET/CLUB_TEST_PASSWORD leaks in page text. Hub (/admin): tournament-card-delete-qa-ta-purge visible on card; hub-purge-test-data-button opens purge-dialog with purge-confirm-button; seed tournaments (la-serie-a-dei-bambini, torneo-degli-amici, future-cup-weekend) are safely unchecked by default while test-prefixed/qa-* tournaments are pre-selected. All qa-ta-* synthetic tournaments and QA SA account removed at cleanup.
action_items: ADVISORY: security-config-errors badge shows '1 da sistemare' (the mfa_admins rule itself is in error state) while 2 real super admin accounts (liviadm15, alessioodt) still have no MFA. Review whether the count label should expose '2 account senza MFA' for clarity, or confirm the intent is 1 failing protection rule.
critical_code_review_comments: tournaments.py:purge_test_data_preview returns 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE with message 'Indica almeno un torneo da conservare' when keep_slugs is empty - this is a validation error, not an authz failure; should return 400/422 to avoid conflating with real role denials and to not pollute /security/summary with phantom admin_denied events.

/api/auth/reauth window appears short (same TOTP code cannot be reused within a 30s TOTP window for consecutive reauths). The DELETE+restore+DELETE cleanup flow needed TOTP rotation between calls; consider a short lived reauth cookie/claim rather than requiring MFA on every protected op.
test_credentials: QA SA qa.superadmin@fsl.demo + password/TOTP from backend/.env (QA_PASSWORD, QA_TOTP_SECRET) - CREATED at start, DELETED at end. Club manager societa.prova@futurestarsleague.com (CLUB_TEST_PASSWORD) - unchanged.
seed_data_creation: Transient only: tournaments 'qa-ta-delete-45' and 'qa-ta-purge' created and deleted inside the run. No real data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration45.py (14 tests, ~8s). Run: pytest tests/test_iteration45.py -v -o 'addopts='. Login flow (API): POST /api/auth/login {email,password} with header X-Client: api -> if MFA required, body has {mfa_required, challenge} -> POST /api/auth/mfa/verify {challenge, code=pyotp.TOTP(secret).now()} with X-Client: api -> access_token (Bearer 20min). For protected ops (DELETE tournament, purge, user delete) also POST /api/auth/reauth {password, code} right before, sharing the same Bearer session. Public tournament response is nested under {'tournament':{...}} not flat. Purge preview requires non-empty keep_slugs or returns 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE (bad: should be 400/422). qa_admin.py create/delete manages the QA SA account.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs. Only two small advisories captured in action_items/critical_code_review_comments. Phase 2 security controls (MFA enforcement, reauth, confirm slug + backup + restore, purge preview, media private streaming with Range, Stripe webhook signature required, payment 404) all behave as specified.
